thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging oncall: sudden spike in embeddings QPS from multiple tenants hitting inference pool 'embed-prod-2'. Error budget approaching and tail latencies > 2s across GPUs. Auto-escalate to oncall
elena_oncall: ACK. Looking at grafana now. can someone post top-talkers and affected routes?
raj_sre: Top sources: /v1/embeddings (55% of excess), /v1/rerank (18%), /v1/chat (12%). Notable client: heavy multi-tenant key 'acct-789' spiking embeddings to ~1.2k rps.
chris_runtime: GPUs showing KV-cache pressure + increased kernel swap. Per-GPU token throughput dropped ~40%.
amanda_support: Support queue: 6 customers reported higher latencies; highest is AcmeCo (account: acct-789) - they hit timeouts on batch jobs.
elena_oncall: Immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) carve per-endpoint soft QPS caps 2) emergency per-route cap for acct-789 3) temporarly disable rerank scoring for lower-tier plans 4) route fallback to quantized model variant. Thoughts?
nina_prod: Agree. Prioritize embeddings cap first (highest load). We can reduce non-enterprise embeddings to 25 rps per API key and set rerank to 5 rps.
raj_sre: Applying soft caps now. executing:
```
# set per-key QPS for embeddings route
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/limits -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_type":"per_key","qps":25}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
raj_sre: Command returned 200. rate limits pushed to edge. Also carving a hot-route for acct-789 to a diminished slice with strict qps=10 to isolate.
chris_runtime: Routed acct-789 to isolated slice `slice-acct-789-hot` and reduced batch size there to 8. Also flipped fallback to quant-8 model for non-enterprise embeddings.
incident-bot: Change applied: per-key embeddings cap=25, per-key rerank cap=5, isolated slice acct-789 qps=10.
amanda_support: Notifying affected customers: AcmeCo ticket updated that we are mitigating and asking for any critical jobs to pause.
liam_custops: FYI, AcmeCo confirmed they had a backfill job running; they've paused one job. Good pickup.
elena_oncall: Handing off active mitigation to nina for follow-up + postmortem. I'll stay on watch for 15m for stabilization.
nina_prod: Got it. I'll collect logs, request traces for the isolated slice, and kick off impact matrix.
raj_sre: Monitoring shows 60% drop in aggregate queue depth and p99 embeddings latency down from 2.1s -> 0.7s over 90s.
chris_runtime: GPU utilization reduced from 94% -> 68% on affected nodes. KV cache eviction rate normalized.
amanda_support: Support note: 3 customers reported improved response, 1 (BetaCo) still seeing retries — looks like their pipeline is retrying very aggressively. Reached out.
elena_oncall: Good. Next actions for postmortem: - timeline of spike - root cause (customer backfills vs client bug) - whether autoscaling should have absorbed this - permanent per-route safe defaults - policy for emergency rerank disable. Assigning: raj for infra playbook, chris for runtime tuning, nina for customer impact doc, amanda for comms.
liam_custops: I'll follow up with AcmeCo about rate-limiting guidance and quota bump requests process.
incident-bot: Runbook event: mitigation_applied by elena_oncall at 4299001182, status=stabilized.
elena_oncall: Closing active paging. We'll reconvene in 1h for postmortem sync. Thanks team :thumbsup:
